page.layout: One column of running text, set left of centre. In the right margin, beside the lines "Atque" to "ganos", one marginal note of three lines. Below the text: the signature "E 4" at left and the catchword "mag-" at right. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: modum afflicta, & cum civitate tota regio vicina in partes distracta, sese attriverant, velut calamitate cautiores factae ab anno M. CC. LII diu deinceps quietae fuere. Post cum minuti tumultus in Agro inter ipsos agrarios ex ambitione hic illic rursus exisserent, deinde majores quoque, imprimis vero in Fivelingiis renascerentur, civitas tamen in quiete perstitit, & quasi spectatrix fabulae fuit. Et quoniam vacillabat saepè jurisdictio in Agro ob partium studia, contumaciamque potentium, quibus pro jure vis ac libido erant, simul etiam commercia actionibus violentis turbabantur, tum firmandorum judiciorum, tum commerciorum tuendorum causa cum his aut illis agri partibus, ut occasio ferebat, pactis fœderi-busque eadem se civitas junxit, eoque modo publicae pacis anchora fuit. AtqueBellum vicinorum in Groninganos. haec pax cum ad annum usque M. CCC. XXXII stetisset, intereaque opibus & negotiationum multitudine oppidani crevissent, eo, quem dixi, anno in dissensionem cum sociis suis, ex dissensione in tumultus, ex tumultibus in apertum & mag-

page.notes: The marginal note's last word "ganos." runs across a line break ("Gronin" / "ganos."); the join is read as "Groninganos" without a printed hyphen, so check it. The numerals are printed in small capitals and are given here as capitals. The scattered marks at the far right edge are not text and are left out. The text "saepè" and "fœderibusque" are read as printed, with the hyphen at the line end kept after "fœderi-".
